notes: Official US nutritional details pages on papajohns.com (pizzas, papadias, sandwiches, wings, sides, desserts, dipping sauces, extras, crust/cheese/sauce/toppings), read in a browser (site blocks plain HTTP clients). Pizzas are per slice; size/crust in the name. The guide lists Epic Stuffed, Thin and Gluten Free columns without a size. Ingredient rows are per slice for build-your-own. Items marked 'no longer available', zero-calorie vegetable toppings, drinks, and Papa Bites/Garlic Knots (carbs printed with an 'mg' unit) were omitted; one Fiery Buffalo Chicken Epic Stuffed value printed as '40mg' carbs was dropped. Fiber shown as '--' recorded as 0.
